mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate (as indicated by the level being below its 6-month moving average) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS has declined over the prior 6 months (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation rate exceeds 300 (index value), it signals persistent inflation that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where CPIAUCSL > 300 (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: The joint strength of housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) above their respective 6-month moving averages indicates a self-reinforcing demand cycle, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 6-month moving averages (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: In a tight labor market (UNRATE < 3.5%), rising wage pressures support corporate profit growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5% (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: A level of industrial production above its 12-month moving average signals sustained economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO > 12mo_avg (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts fall below 1400 thousand units, it signals a weakening in the housing market and broader consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where HOUST < 1400 (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: The joint condition of a federal funds rate above 4.0% and CPI inflation above 300 (index) signals aggressive monetary tightening in response to high inflation, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 45% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.0 and CPIAUCSL > 300 (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 growth rate above 2.5% but declining), the market anticipates a slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where GDPC1 growth > 2.5% and declining (t-test p>0.05 vs baseline).
